✨ WHAT'S BEEN CREATED:
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

9 Production-Ready Files:

1. Dockerfile.rpi.clean (5.7K)
   └─ ARM/ARM64 optimized Dockerfile
   └─ Clean build - excludes all execution data
   └─ Python 3.11 slim base image
   └─ Includes all dependencies from requirements.txt

2. docker-compose.rpi.clean.yml (5.0K)
   └─ Service orchestration & deployment config
   └─ Defines volumes, ports, environment, resource limits
   └─ One service: rdk-middleware-dashboard

3. docker-entrypoint.sh (6.8K)
   └─ Container startup initialization script
   └─ Validates configuration files
   └─ Creates necessary directories
   └─ Initializes JSON state files
   └─ Sets environment variables

4. .dockerignore.rpi.clean (4.5K)
   └─ Build filter - specifies what NOT to include
   └─ Excludes execution data (logs, screenshots)
   └─ Excludes IDE/git files
   └─ Ensures minimal, fast Docker image

5. rpi4-setup-complete.sh (12K) - ⭐ MAIN SETUP SCRIPT
   └─ Automated one-command deployment
   └─ Checks system requirements
   └─ Installs Docker & Docker Compose
   └─ Builds Docker image
   └─ Starts services
   └─ Verifies healthy startup

6. docker-verify-setup.sh (7.6K)
   └─ Pre-deployment verification tool
   └─ Checks all required files
   └─ Verifies Docker installation
   └─ Tests system requirements
   └─ Validates configuration

7. DOCKER_SETUP_GUIDE_RPI4.md (13K)
   └─ Comprehensive 500+ line documentation
   └─ Quick start, manual installation, configuration
   └─ Container management, troubleshooting
   └─ Production recommendations

8. DOCKER_QUICK_REFERENCE.txt (13K)
   └─ Docker commands cheat sheet
   └─ Essential operations quick lookup
   └─ Copy/paste ready commands

9. DOCKER_COMPLETE_SETUP.md (15K)
   └─ Setup overview and architecture
   └─ File descriptions
   └─ Deployment instructions


🎯 DEPLOYMENT WORKFLOW:
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

STEP 1: PREPARE RASPBERRY PI
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
✓ Ensure RPi 4 is powered up
✓ Connected to network (Ethernet recommended)
✓ SSH access available (or direct terminal)
✓ 4GB+ RAM available
✓ 64GB+ storage available

STEP 2: COPY PROJECT TO RPi
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
From your computer:

  scp -r /path/to/Enhancement pi@<rpi-ip>:~/

Or copy via USB/external drive if preferred.

STEP 3: SSH INTO RPi
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ssh pi@<rpi-ip>

STEP 4: NAVIGATE TO PROJECT
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cd ~/Enhancement

STEP 5: RUN DEPLOYMENT SCRIPT
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ./rpi4-setup-complete.sh

  This script will:
  ✓ Verify system meets requirements
  ✓ Install Docker (if needed)
  ✓ Install Docker Compose (if needed)
  ✓ Build the clean Docker image (5-10 minutes)
  ✓ Start the application container
  ✓ Verify healthy startup
  ✓ Show access URL

STEP 6: ACCESS DASHBOARD
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Open browser: http://<rpi-ip>:11078

  Example:
  http://192.168.1.100:11078
  http://10.0.0.123:11078

DONE! ✨
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


🚀 QUICK START COMMANDS:
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

ONE-LINER (Recommended):
  chmod +x rpi4-setup-complete.sh && ./rpi4-setup-complete.sh

VERIFY SETUP FIRST:
  ./docker-verify-setup.sh

VIEW LOGS DURING/AFTER BUILD:
  docker logs -f rdk-middleware-dashboard

VIEW ALL LOGS:
  docker-compose -f docker-compose.rpi.clean.yml logs -f

RESTART APPLICATION:
  docker-compose -f docker-compose.rpi.clean.yml restart

STOP APPLICATION:
  docker-compose -f docker-compose.rpi.clean.yml stop

START APPLICATION:
  docker-compose -f docker-compose.rpi.clean.yml start

REMOVE APPLICATION:
  docker-compose -f docker-compose.rpi.clean.yml down


📦 IMAGE BUILD SPECIFICATIONS:
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Base Image:
  python:3.11-slim (ARM/ARM64 compatible)

Image Size:
  ~800MB-1GB (optimized for RPi)

Build Time:
  5-10 minutes on RPi 4 (first build)
  2-3 minutes on RPi 5 or with SSD

Architecture:
  ARM/ARM64 (works on RPi 3, 4, 5)

Included Components:
  ✓ Python 3.11 + pip
  ✓ Tesseract OCR
  ✓ OpenCV & image processing
  ✓ Paramiko (SSH client)
  ✓ Gunicorn & Gevent
  ✓ Flask & all dependencies
  ✓ All application code + latest changes

NOT Included (Clean Build):
  ❌ Execution logs
  ❌ Previous screenshots
  ❌ Old device logs
  ❌ Git history
  ❌ IDE files
  ❌ Development artifacts


🔐 SECURITY & CONFIGURATION:
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

By Default (development/testing):
  • SECRET_KEY: Basic default (change for production)
  • Email: Disabled (no credentials)
  • HTTPS: Not configured (use reverse proxy)
  • Log Level: INFO

For Production (edit docker-compose.rpi.clean.yml):

  1. Generate secure secret key:
     python3 -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))"

  2. Set environment:
     SECRET_KEY: "<your-32-char-key>"

  3. Enable email notifications:
     SMTP_USER: "your-email@gmail.com"
     SMTP_PASSWORD: "your-16-char-app-password"

  4. Then restart:
     docker-compose -f docker-compose.rpi.clean.yml restart


📊 RESOURCE OPTIMIZATION:
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Default Settings (RPi 4 with 4GB):
  • CPU Limit: 1 core
  • Memory Limit: 512MB
  • Workers: 2 Gunicorn workers
  • Refresh Rate: 10 seconds

For 8GB RPi / RPi 5 (edit docker-compose.rpi.clean.yml):
  • CPU Limit: 2 cores
  • Memory Limit: 1024MB
  • Workers: 4 Gunicorn workers
  • Performance Boost: ~40%

Monitor Resource Usage:
  docker stats rdk-middleware-dashboard


💾 DATA PERSISTENCE:
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

All data is stored in persistent Docker volumes:

✓ app_data volume:
  └─ /app/data/screenshots/     - Captured test screenshots
  └─ /app/data/iteration_logs/  - Execution logs
  └─ /app/data/device_logs/     - Collected device logs
  └─ /app/data/sessions/        - User session data
  └─ /app/data/app_logs/        - Application logs

✓ reference_screens volume:
  └─ /app/reference_screens/    - Screen validation references

Data Persistence:
  ✓ Survives container restart
  ✓ Survives application update
  ✓ Survives image rebuild
  ✓ Only lost if volumes explicitly deleted


🔄 UPDATING APPLICATION:
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Process to Update Code:

  1. Update source files on RPi
  2. Rebuild Docker image:
     docker build -f Dockerfile.rpi.clean \
       -t rdk-middleware-dashboard:rpi4-clean .

  3. Stop current container:
     docker-compose -f docker-compose.rpi.clean.yml down

  4. Start with new image:
     docker-compose -f docker-compose.rpi.clean.yml up -d

  5. Verify startup:
     docker logs -f rdk-middleware-dashboard

All previous data (executions, screenshots, etc.) persists!


🐛 TROUBLESHOOTING QUICK REFERENCE:
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

❌ Container won't start:
   docker logs rdk-middleware-dashboard
   → Check for missing files or invalid syntax

❌ Web UI not accessible:
   curl http://localhost:11078
   → Verify container is running: docker ps

❌ Port 11078 already in use:
   netstat -tulpn | grep 11078
   → Change port in docker-compose.rpi.clean.yml

❌ High memory usage:
   docker stats rdk-middleware-dashboard
   → Reduce memory limit in docker-compose.rpi.clean.yml

❌ Slow performance:
   docker stats --no-stream
   → Increase resources for 8GB RPi
   → Or reduce number of concurrent jobs

For comprehensive troubleshooting:
  cat DOCKER_SETUP_GUIDE_RPI4.md

🖥️ ACCESSING DASHBOARD:
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Finding Your RPi IP:

From RPi terminal:
  hostname -I

From another computer:
  # Linux/Mac
  arp-scan --localnet | grep -i raspberry

  # Or SSH and run hostname -I
  ssh pi@<known-rpi-ip> hostname -I

Accessing Dashboard:
  http://<rpi-ip>:11078

  Examples:
  http://192.168.1.100:11078
  http://10.0.0.123:11078
  http://raspberrypi.local:11078 (if mDNS works)


✅ FINAL CHECKLIST:
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Before Deployment:
  □ RPi 4 with 4GB+ RAM powered up
  □ Connected to network
  □ 64GB+ storage available
  □ Project files copied to RPi
  □ SSH access verified
  □ ~10-15 minutes available

During Deployment:
  □ Run ./rpi4-setup-complete.sh
  □ Wait for Docker build to complete
  □ Watch for success messages
  □ Note the access URL

After Deployment:
  □ Browser shows dashboard at http://<ip>:11078
  □ Can add devices
  □ Can execute tests
  □ Logs show no errors


🎉 GET HELP:
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Documentation:
  cat DOCKER_COMPLETE_SETUP.md          # This file
  cat DOCKER_SETUP_GUIDE_RPI4.md        # Full guide
  cat DOCKER_QUICK_REFERENCE.txt        # Commands

Pre-Deployment Check:
  ./docker-verify-setup.sh

View Logs:
  docker logs rdk-middleware-dashboard
  docker-compose -f docker-compose.rpi.clean.yml logs -f

Container Status:
  docker ps
  docker stats rdk-middleware-dashboard

SSH into Container:
  docker exec -it rdk-middleware-dashboard bash

Check Data Volume:
  docker exec rdk-middleware-dashboard ls -la /app/data/
